gear-armour#0240.flat: This perfect-to-the-point-of-indistinguishability replica mask of Herbert von Legendary's face, painstakingly crafted by Corkus's most powerful machines with only the most expensive materials and featuring real moustache hair plucked from Doctor Legendary's face, is desperately handed over to attempt to placate those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, pushed onward to prove that they will not stop spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then ultimately garnered an unhealthy obsession for spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

gear-armour#0241.src: This battered stone mask is of unknown origin, and has no openings for the eyes whatsoever. Indeed, all that can be seen while wearing it is that which makes you truly angry.
gear-armour#0241.dst: Diese ramponierte Steinmaske ist unbekannter Herkunft und hat keinerlei Öffnungen für die Augen. Tatsächlich sieht man beim Tragen nur das, was einen wirklich wütend macht.
gear-armour#0241.flat: This battered stone mask is of unknown origin, and has no openings for the eyes whatsoever. Indeed, all that can be seen while wearing it is that which makes you truly angry.

gear-armour#0242.src: Every ounce of your suffering must be made worth it. Otherwise, what was the point of it all?
gear-armour#0242.dst: Jedes Quäntchen deines Leidens muss sich lohnen. Wozu wäre sonst alles gut gewesen?
gear-armour#0242.flat: Every ounce of your suffering must be made worth it. Otherwise, what was the point of it all?

gear-armour#0243.src: There is nothing in these walls that will remain hidden forever. Nothing unaccounted for by the gleaming light of The Citadel.
gear-armour#0243.dst: Nichts innerhalb dieser Mauern bleibt für immer verborgen. Nichts entgeht dem gleißenden Licht der Zitadelle.
gear-armour#0243.flat: There is nothing in these walls that will remain hidden forever. Nothing unaccounted for by the gleaming light of The Citadel.

gear-armour#0244.src: A brilliant relic supposedly originating from the Realm of Light, the creators of these strangely shaped boots are completely unknown.
gear-armour#0244.dst: Ein strahlendes Relikt, das angeblich aus dem Reich des Lichts stammt; die Schöpfer dieser seltsam geformten Stiefel sind völlig unbekannt.
gear-armour#0244.flat: A brilliant relic supposedly originating from the Realm of Light, the creators of these strangely shaped boots are completely unknown.

gear-armour#0245.src: Occasional whisperings can be heard by the wearers of this stone mask, reforged from a phylactery of souls. Although not dangerous, staring into the eyes of the mask can bring fear of one's soul being trapped within.
gear-armour#0245.dst: Wer diese Steinmaske trägt, die aus einem Seelengefäß umgeschmiedet wurde, hört gelegentlich ein Flüstern. Sie ist zwar nicht gefährlich, doch wer in ihre Augen starrt, kann die Angst bekommen, die eigene Seele sei darin gefangen.
gear-armour#0245.flat: Occasional whisperings can be heard by the wearers of this stone mask, reforged from a phylactery of souls. Although not dangerous, staring into the eyes of the mask can bring fear of one's soul being trapped within.

gear-armour#0246.src: Able to withstand the grasp of claws of pure steel, the perch of the Minokawa thrums with the might of a beast that can devour the sun. Given free reign of the skies, even the brightest of stars are no match.
gear-armour#0246.dst: Die Sitzstange des Minokawa hält dem Griff von Klauen aus reinem Stahl stand und bebt mit der Macht eines Untiers, das die Sonne verschlingen kann. Hat es freie Herrschaft über den Himmel, können selbst die hellsten Sterne nicht mithalten.
gear-armour#0246.flat: Able to withstand the grasp of claws of pure steel, the perch of the Minokawa thrums with the might of a beast that can devour the sun. Given free reign of the skies, even the brightest of stars are no match.

gear-armour#0247.src: Salvaged from the limbs of the Vulcor Adrenophage, they radiate extreme heat,  suffusing the body they attach to with that same heat. It almost feels as though your blood is heating to a frenetic boil.
gear-armour#0247.dst: Aus den Gliedmaßen des Vulcor Adrenophage geborgen, strahlen sie extreme Hitze aus,  die den Körper, an dem sie haften, mit derselben Hitze durchdringt. Fast fühlt es sich an, als würde dein Blut bis zum rasenden Sieden erhitzt.
gear-armour#0247.flat: Salvaged from the limbs of the Vulcor Adrenophage, they radiate extreme heat,  suffusing the body they attach to with that same heat. It almost feels as though your blood is heating to a frenetic boil.

gear-armour#0248.src: An age of transformation. To shape the evolution of life, as if molding a piece of clay. To gain intelligence, and become the harbingers of creation and destruction. To build control, and become the hand of fate. Here, we begin.
gear-armour#0248.dst: Ein Zeitalter der Verwandlung. Die Entwicklung des Lebens zu formen wie ein Stück Ton. Intelligenz zu erlangen und zu Vorboten von Schöpfung und Zerstörung zu werden. Kontrolle aufzubauen und zur Hand des Schicksals zu werden. Hier beginnen wir.
gear-armour#0248.flat: An age of transformation. To shape the evolution of life, as if molding a piece of clay. To gain intelligence, and become the harbingers of creation and destruction. To build control, and become the hand of fate. Here, we begin.

gear-armour#0249.src: A soul sacrificed willingly, to an eternity in captivity. Imprints and memories; all that remain of a hero of the lands.
gear-armour#0249.dst: Eine freiwillig geopferte Seele, für eine Ewigkeit in Gefangenschaft. Abdrücke und Erinnerungen; alles, was von einem Helden dieser Lande bleibt.
gear-armour#0249.flat: A soul sacrificed willingly, to an eternity in captivity. Imprints and memories; all that remain of a hero of the lands.

gear-armour#0250.src: Memories take on lives of their own, left long enough.
gear-armour#0250.dst: Lässt man Erinnerungen lange genug allein, entwickeln sie ein Eigenleben.
gear-armour#0250.flat: Memories take on lives of their own, left long enough.

gear-armour#0251.src: What better excuse is there to sit in the shade and think about life?
gear-armour#0251.dst: Gibt es eine bessere Ausrede, um sich in den Schatten zu setzen und über das Leben nachzudenken?
gear-armour#0251.flat: What better excuse is there to sit in the shade and think about life?

gear-armour#0252.src: Rivers will run red in your wake.
gear-armour#0252.dst: Flüsse werden auf deinem Weg rot fließen.
gear-armour#0252.flat: Rivers will run red in your wake.

gear-armour#0253.src: The Phoenix Prince is a mythical figure spoken of in Avos legend. His crown cursed him in an endless cycle of death and rebirth.
gear-armour#0253.dst: Der Phönixprinz ist eine sagenhafte Gestalt aus den Legenden der Avos. Seine Krone verfluchte ihn zu einem endlosen Kreislauf aus Tod und Wiedergeburt.
gear-armour#0253.flat: The Phoenix Prince is a mythical figure spoken of in Avos legend. His crown cursed him in an endless cycle of death and rebirth.

gear-armour#0254.src: The sweater has the quote "Let me NICK a few extra cookies for Craftmas" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0254.dst: Auf die Vorderseite des Pullovers ist der Spruch "Let me NICK a few extra cookies for Craftmas" gestrickt.
gear-armour#0254.flat: The sweater has the quote "Let me NICK a few extra cookies for Craftmas" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0255.src: The sweater has the quote "Going HAM on Craftmas dinner tonight" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0255.dst: Auf die Vorderseite des Pullovers ist der Spruch "Going HAM on Craftmas dinner tonight" gestrickt.
gear-armour#0255.flat: The sweater has the quote "Going HAM on Craftmas dinner tonight" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0256.src: The oddly uncomfortable helmet was hand sculpted from a mystic clay found only in the depths of {p}. Not much is known about the substance.
gear-armour#0256.dst: Der seltsam unbequeme Helm wurde von Hand aus einem mystischen Ton geformt, den es nur in den Tiefen von {p} gibt. Über die Substanz ist nicht viel bekannt.
gear-armour#0256.flat: The oddly uncomfortable helmet was hand sculpted from a mystic clay found only in the depths of {p}. Not much is known about the substance.
gear-armour#0256._raw: The oddly uncomfortable helmet was hand sculpted from a mystic clay found only in the depths of Molten Heights. Not much is known about the substance.

gear-armour#0257.src: The intersection of what can be and what is. The apotheosis of being. Shear away the unclean, the impure, the rotten; leave only the raw, blinding truth of the self.
gear-armour#0257.dst: Der Schnittpunkt dessen, was sein kann, und dessen, was ist. Die Apotheose des Seins. Schneide das Unreine, das Unlautere, das Verfaulte fort; lass nur die rohe, blendende Wahrheit des Selbst zurück.
gear-armour#0257.flat: The intersection of what can be and what is. The apotheosis of being. Shear away the unclean, the impure, the rotten; leave only the raw, blinding truth of the self.

gear-armour#0258.src: These leggings are the last remaining piece of a historical set of armor, created with such power as to be thought impossible long ago.
gear-armour#0258.dst: Diese Hose ist das letzte verbliebene Stück einer geschichtsträchtigen Rüstung, die einst mit einer Macht geschaffen wurde, die man für unmöglich hielt.
gear-armour#0258.flat: These leggings are the last remaining piece of a historical set of armor, created with such power as to be thought impossible long ago.

gear-armour#0259.src: Smooth yet unassuming, this hollowed piece feels as if it lay untouched for millennia as the chaos that formed eastern Gavel unfolded around it. No blemish nor order, just nature preserved in its most perfect form.
gear-armour#0259.dst: Glatt und doch unscheinbar fühlt sich dieses ausgehöhlte Stück an, als hätte es Jahrtausende unberührt gelegen, während sich ringsum das Chaos entfaltete, das das östliche Gavel formte. Kein Makel und keine Ordnung, nur Natur, bewahrt in ihrer vollkommensten Form.
gear-armour#0259.flat: Smooth yet unassuming, this hollowed piece feels as if it lay untouched for millennia as the chaos that formed eastern Gavel unfolded around it. No blemish nor order, just nature preserved in its most perfect form.

gear-armour#0260.src: A tag on the inside of the hat reads: "Do not fly during thunderstorms! The wearer is liable for all injuries sustained while using this product."
gear-armour#0260.dst: Auf einem Etikett im Inneren des Hutes steht: "Bei Gewitter nicht fliegen! Der Träger haftet für alle Verletzungen, die bei der Nutzung dieses Produkts entstehen."
gear-armour#0260.flat: A tag on the inside of the hat reads: "Do not fly during thunderstorms! The wearer is liable for all injuries sustained while using this product."

gear-armour#0261.src: A wolf and a rabbit met in the woods. The rabbit was injured; the wolf spared it. The two grew close. One day, the rabbit fell into a hunter's trap. It was terrified, surrounded by armed men. The wolf burst from the trees, fighting the men back, even as they shot it with their bows, long enough for the rabbit to run away. It never saw the wolf again.
gear-armour#0261.dst: Ein Wolf und ein Hase begegneten sich im Wald. Der Hase war verletzt; der Wolf verschonte ihn. Die beiden wurden enge Freunde. Eines Tages geriet der Hase in die Falle eines Jägers. Er war voller Angst, umzingelt von bewaffneten Männern. Der Wolf brach aus den Bäumen hervor und hielt die Männer zurück, selbst als sie ihn mit ihren Bögen beschossen, lange genug, damit der Hase fliehen konnte. Er sah den Wolf nie wieder.
gear-armour#0261.flat: A wolf and a rabbit met in the woods. The rabbit was injured; the wolf spared it. The two grew close. One day, the rabbit fell into a hunter's trap. It was terrified, surrounded by armed men. The wolf burst from the trees, fighting the men back, even as they shot it with their bows, long enough for the rabbit to run away. It never saw the wolf again.

gear-armour#0262.src: An age of oxidation. To assert that you will remain, and others all across the world will be left behind. To overwhelm everything with toxic air, ensuring that extinctions follow your wake. Some stop breathing, but the gears of time march on.
gear-armour#0262.dst: Ein Zeitalter der Oxidation. Zu behaupten, dass du bleiben und andere überall auf der Welt zurückbleiben werden. Alles mit giftiger Luft zu überwältigen und dafür zu sorgen, dass dir das Aussterben folgt. Manche hören auf zu atmen, doch die Zahnräder der Zeit drehen sich weiter.
gear-armour#0262.flat: An age of oxidation. To assert that you will remain, and others all across the world will be left behind. To overwhelm everything with toxic air, ensuring that extinctions follow your wake. Some stop breathing, but the gears of time march on.

gear-armour#0263.src: In the shadow of the Sun, a storm of unmistakable hatred follows. One which, however ephemeral, may only yield to the great pyres like these in the minutes it has to spare.
gear-armour#0263.dst: Im Schatten der Sonne folgt ein Sturm unverkennbaren Hasses. Einer, der, wie flüchtig er auch sei, in den Minuten, die ihm bleiben, nur großen Scheiterhaufen wie diesen weichen mag.
gear-armour#0263.flat: In the shadow of the Sun, a storm of unmistakable hatred follows. One which, however ephemeral, may only yield to the great pyres like these in the minutes it has to spare.

gear-armour#0264.src: The sweater has the quote "ICY you looking at my fancy duds" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0264.dst: Auf die Vorderseite des Pullovers ist der Spruch "ICY you looking at my fancy duds" gestrickt.
gear-armour#0264.flat: The sweater has the quote "ICY you looking at my fancy duds" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0265.src: This patchwork of shells from the Corkian Astrochelys makes for quite the statement sweater; it keeps your neck warm and besides, your foes' fashion fancies feel frivolous, anyway.
gear-armour#0265.dst: Dieses Flickwerk aus Panzern der Corkischen Astrochelys ergibt einen echten Statement-Pullover; er hält deinen Hals warm, und die modischen Launen deiner Feinde wirken ohnehin frivol.
gear-armour#0265.flat: This patchwork of shells from the Corkian Astrochelys makes for quite the statement sweater; it keeps your neck warm and besides, your foes' fashion fancies feel frivolous, anyway.

gear-armour#0266.src: Radioactive emissions caused by starfall seeps into the mind, the atoms, the Soul. Transfiguring organic matter into something new, something sinister. It's only through sheer force of will that victims of such a thing break free from themselves, and their imperfect vessels... into something beautiful.
gear-armour#0266.dst: Radioaktive Strahlung aus dem Sternenfall sickert in den Geist, die Atome, die Seele. Sie verwandelt organische Materie in etwas Neues, etwas Finsteres. Nur durch reine Willenskraft befreien sich die Opfer davon, von sich selbst und ihren unvollkommenen Gefäßen... und werden zu etwas Schönem.
gear-armour#0266.flat: Radioactive emissions caused by starfall seeps into the mind, the atoms, the Soul. Transfiguring organic matter into something new, something sinister. It's only through sheer force of will that victims of such a thing break free from themselves, and their imperfect vessels... into something beautiful.

gear-armour#0267.src: One of the few remaining standard issue mails that were used against the first hordes to emerge from the infamous portal over {~} years ago.
gear-armour#0267.dst: Eines der wenigen verbliebenen Standardkettenhemden, die gegen die ersten Horden eingesetzt wurden, die vor über {~} Jahren aus dem berüchtigten Portal kamen.
gear-armour#0267.flat: One of the few remaining standard issue mails that were used against the first hordes to emerge from the infamous portal over {~} years ago.
gear-armour#0267._raw: One of the few remaining standard issue mails that were used against the first hordes to emerge from the infamous portal over 1000 years ago.

gear-armour#0268.src: The harmony of the elements, a world which sings its truth for all who dare listen, words spoken which can be felt but never known. The Sanctuary, in its whole.
gear-armour#0268.dst: Die Harmonie der Elemente, eine Welt, die ihre Wahrheit allen vorsingt, die zu lauschen wagen, gesprochene Worte, die man fühlen, aber nie erkennen kann. Das Heiligtum in seiner Gesamtheit.
gear-armour#0268.flat: The harmony of the elements, a world which sings its truth for all who dare listen, words spoken which can be felt but never known. The Sanctuary, in its whole.

gear-armour#0270.src: The sweater has the quote "I'll never give you the COLD SHOULDER" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0270.dst: Auf die Vorderseite des Pullovers ist der Spruch "I'll never give you the COLD SHOULDER" gestrickt.
gear-armour#0270.flat: The sweater has the quote "I'll never give you the COLD SHOULDER" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0271.src: Ancient and new hearts beat as one.
gear-armour#0271.dst: Alte und neue Herzen schlagen wie eins.
gear-armour#0271.flat: Ancient and new hearts beat as one.

gear-armour#0272.src: Found on the mangled body of a famous Tromsian general fallen to a corrupted siege some time ago, these boots allow the wearer to remain calm and steadfast in the face of overwhelming odds.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0272.dst: Diese Stiefel wurden an der zerschmetterten Leiche eines berühmten Generals aus Troms gefunden, der vor einiger Zeit bei einer Belagerung durch die Verderbten fiel. Sie lassen ihren Träger angesichts übermächtiger Gegner ruhig und standhaft bleiben.Es zieht zu etwas hin.
gear-armour#0272.flat: Found on the mangled body of a famous Tromsian general fallen to a corrupted siege some time ago, these boots allow the wearer to remain calm and steadfast in the face of overwhelming odds.It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0273.src: When the Colossus they called Protector raised its sword, splintering the land like glass, the void opened its jaws to swallow the world. Earthenware dredged from the abyss were reshaped into pieces of armor. They pull at your heels like leaden anchors, and carry the strength of bedrock.
gear-armour#0273.dst: Als der Koloss, den man Beschützer nannte, sein Schwert erhob und das Land wie Glas zersplittern ließ, öffnete die Leere ihren Schlund, um die Welt zu verschlingen. Aus dem Abgrund gefischte Tonwaren wurden zu Rüstungsteilen umgeformt. Sie ziehen an deinen Fersen wie bleierne Anker und tragen die Stärke des Grundgesteins.
gear-armour#0273.flat: When the Colossus they called Protector raised its sword, splintering the land like glass, the void opened its jaws to swallow the world. Earthenware dredged from the abyss were reshaped into pieces of armor. They pull at your heels like leaden anchors, and carry the strength of bedrock.

gear-armour#0274.src: In the moments before an all but inescapable death, time slows down, and the pace of battle becomes yours. By mastering the escape, you can face death on command, reaping the benefits at will before the reaper reaches you.
gear-armour#0274.dst: In den Momenten vor einem nahezu unausweichlichen Tod verlangsamt sich die Zeit, und du bestimmst das Tempo des Kampfes. Beherrschst du die Flucht, kannst du dem Tod auf Befehl entgegentreten und nach Belieben die Früchte ernten, bevor der Sensenmann dich erreicht.
gear-armour#0274.flat: In the moments before an all but inescapable death, time slows down, and the pace of battle becomes yours. By mastering the escape, you can face death on command, reaping the benefits at will before the reaper reaches you.

gear-armour#0275.src: An antique passed from the Caritat wreckage into the hands of the outcast elves of {p}. So to honor the memory of the selfless family as inspired their self-imposed exile, their strongest healing spells were imbued into it, and sent to those who needed them most.
gear-armour#0275.dst: Eine Antiquität, die aus dem Wrack der Caritat in die Hände der verstoßenen Elfen von {p} gelangte. Um das Andenken der selbstlosen Familie zu ehren, die ihr selbst gewähltes Exil angeregt hatte, wurden ihre stärksten Heilzauber hineingelegt, und sie wurde zu denen geschickt, die sie am dringendsten brauchten.
gear-armour#0275.flat: An antique passed from the Caritat wreckage into the hands of the outcast elves of {p}. So to honor the memory of the selfless family as inspired their self-imposed exile, their strongest healing spells were imbued into it, and sent to those who needed them most.
gear-armour#0275._raw: An antique passed from the Caritat wreckage into the hands of the outcast elves of Efilim. So to honor the memory of the selfless family as inspired their self-imposed exile, their strongest healing spells were imbued into it, and sent to those who needed them most.

gear-armour#0276.src: Those whose souls are lost to the {p} eternally seek form. They inhabit those who wear these boots, unknowingly dragging the soul of the wearer into their ranks if worn for too long, leaving a wandering husk.
gear-armour#0276.dst: Wessen Seele in {p} verloren ist, sucht ewig nach einer Gestalt. Sie bewohnen jene, die diese Stiefel tragen, und ziehen die Seele des Trägers unbemerkt in ihre Reihen, wenn er sie zu lange trägt, sodass nur eine wandelnde Hülle bleibt.
gear-armour#0276.flat: Those whose souls are lost to the {p} eternally seek form. They inhabit those who wear these boots, unknowingly dragging the soul of the wearer into their ranks if worn for too long, leaving a wandering husk.
gear-armour#0276._raw: Those whose souls are lost to the Canyon of the Lost eternally seek form. They inhabit those who wear these boots, unknowingly dragging the soul of the wearer into their ranks if worn for too long, leaving a wandering husk.

gear-armour#0277.src: This ornate decorative mask, fashioned from pure silver, is awarded to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge and broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge.
gear-armour#0277.dst: Diese kunstvolle Ziermaske aus reinem Silber wird jenen verliehen, die unnötig viel Zeit damit verbracht haben, die Legendary Challenge abzuschließen, und mit allen Konventionen gebrochen haben, indem sie weiter unnötig viel Zeit damit verbrachten, die Legendary Challenge abzuschließen.
ctx: armour/Revered Silver Mask of Legendary Victory/lore
gear-armour#0277.flat: This ornate decorative mask, fashioned from pure silver, is awarded to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge and broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

gear-armour#0278.src: Look at the road behind you. The familiar warmth of your journey proves you haven't forgotten your roots, and the familiar faces still standing by your side proves that they are here to stay.
gear-armour#0278.dst: Sieh auf den Weg hinter dir. Die vertraute Wärme deiner Reise beweist, dass du deine Wurzeln nicht vergessen hast, und die vertrauten Gesichter, die noch an deiner Seite stehen, beweisen, dass sie bleiben werden.
gear-armour#0278.flat: Look at the road behind you. The familiar warmth of your journey proves you haven't forgotten your roots, and the familiar faces still standing by your side proves that they are here to stay.

gear-armour#0279.src: You will do what is right, whether they like it or not.
gear-armour#0279.dst: Du wirst tun, was richtig ist, ob es ihnen gefällt oder nicht.
gear-armour#0279.flat: You will do what is right, whether they like it or not.

gear-armour#0280.src: A rage has built up in the stones around you. A slow burn, a creeping fury gradually grown throughout the ages. It demands release.
gear-armour#0280.dst: In den Steinen um dich herum hat sich Wut angestaut. Ein langsames Glimmen, ein schleichender Zorn, der über die Zeitalter allmählich gewachsen ist. Er verlangt nach Entladung.
gear-armour#0280.flat: A rage has built up in the stones around you. A slow burn, a creeping fury gradually grown throughout the ages. It demands release.

gear-armour#0281.src: "...as intimidating as the name sounds, you want your organs to be trapped in this kind of cage." -Excerpt from Human Anatomy For Fools, Cirh Nettan
gear-armour#0281.dst: "...so einschüchternd der Name klingt, du willst, dass deine Organe in genau so einem Käfig stecken." -Auszug aus Menschliche Anatomie für Dummköpfe, Cirh Nettan
gear-armour#0281.flat: "...as intimidating as the name sounds, you want your organs to be trapped in this kind of cage." -Excerpt from Human Anatomy For Fools, Cirh Nettan

gear-armour#0282.src: To fight for a cause so overwhelmingly greater than themselves, under that lofty, unreachable banner. What will they do if it all comes crumbling down; when beliefs and ideals rot away, reduced to naught but ash?
gear-armour#0282.dst: Für eine Sache zu kämpfen, die so überwältigend größer ist als man selbst, unter diesem erhabenen, unerreichbaren Banner. Was werden sie tun, wenn alles in sich zusammenfällt; wenn Glaube und Ideale verfaulen, zu nichts als Asche zerfallen?
gear-armour#0282.flat: To fight for a cause so overwhelmingly greater than themselves, under that lofty, unreachable banner. What will they do if it all comes crumbling down; when beliefs and ideals rot away, reduced to naught but ash?

gear-armour#0283.src: You know better than anyone else that there's always a sliver of truth behind the tallest of tales.
gear-armour#0283.dst: Du weißt besser als jeder andere, dass hinter den wildesten Geschichten immer ein Körnchen Wahrheit steckt.
gear-armour#0283.flat: You know better than anyone else that there's always a sliver of truth behind the tallest of tales.

gear-armour#0284.src: The hide of the centaur is extraordinarily magical in the right hands. It is told to allow the user to gain the swiftness of the horse, but also leaves them vulnerable to hard hitting attacks.
gear-armour#0284.dst: Das Fell des Zentauren ist in den richtigen Händen außerordentlich magisch. Man erzählt, es verleihe seinem Träger die Schnelligkeit des Pferdes, mache ihn aber auch anfällig für harte Treffer.
gear-armour#0284.flat: The hide of the centaur is extraordinarily magical in the right hands. It is told to allow the user to gain the swiftness of the horse, but also leaves them vulnerable to hard hitting attacks.

gear-armour#0285.src: Countless lifetimes flash by in an instant. Will you break the cycle, or be consumed by the tides of eternity?
gear-armour#0285.dst: Unzählige Leben ziehen in einem Augenblick vorbei. Wirst du den Kreislauf durchbrechen oder von den Gezeiten der Ewigkeit verschlungen werden?
gear-armour#0285.flat: Countless lifetimes flash by in an instant. Will you break the cycle, or be consumed by the tides of eternity?

gear-armour#0286.src: Blood, gore, and bone fragments have congealed to your shoulder with the power of sheer corruption. The longer the mass is attached to you, the more of you it takes when you try to remove it.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0286.dst: Blut, Gedärm und Knochensplitter sind durch die schiere Kraft der Verderbnis an deiner Schulter geronnen. Je länger die Masse an dir haftet, desto mehr von dir nimmt sie mit, wenn du versuchst, sie zu entfernen.Es zieht zu etwas hin.
gear-armour#0286.flat: Blood, gore, and bone fragments have congealed to your shoulder with the power of sheer corruption. The longer the mass is attached to you, the more of you it takes when you try to remove it.It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0287.src: Once cursed by a druid who had his grove chopped away by a greedy Villager, it was then purified and mass-produced for sale as armor, to the druid's utter disappointment.
gear-armour#0287.dst: Einst verflucht von einem Druiden, dessen Hain ein gieriger Dorfbewohner abgeholzt hatte, wurde es später gereinigt und als Rüstung in Massen zum Verkauf hergestellt, zur völligen Enttäuschung des Druiden.
gear-armour#0287.flat: Once cursed by a druid who had his grove chopped away by a greedy Villager, it was then purified and mass-produced for sale as armor, to the druid's utter disappointment.

gear-armour#0288.src: You're seeing red... Time to see more of it.
gear-armour#0288.dst: Du siehst rot... Zeit, mehr davon zu sehen.
gear-armour#0288.flat: You're seeing red... Time to see more of it.

gear-armour#0289.src: The sweater has the quote "Why be merry? CLAUS I said so" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0289.dst: Auf die Vorderseite des Pullovers ist der Spruch "Why be merry? CLAUS I said so" gestrickt.
gear-armour#0289.flat: The sweater has the quote "Why be merry? CLAUS I said so" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0290.src: It's a wicked dream come true-their purpose is pain, both others' and their own; their will is naught but your command.
gear-armour#0290.dst: Ein böser Traum, der wahr geworden ist-ihr Zweck ist Schmerz, der anderer wie ihr eigener; ihr Wille ist nichts als dein Befehl.
gear-armour#0290.flat: It's a wicked dream come true-their purpose is pain, both others' and their own; their will is naught but your command.

gear-armour#0291.src: These hollowed spikes still hold the lingering embers of the event that formed this caldera long ago, lending an almost unnatural glow. It's a comforting warmth, though the force of the eruption remains dormant, primed for the slightest push.
gear-armour#0291.dst: Diese hohlen Stacheln bergen noch die glimmende Glut des Ereignisses, das diese Caldera vor langer Zeit formte, und verleihen ihr ein fast unnatürliches Leuchten. Es ist eine tröstliche Wärme, doch die Kraft des Ausbruchs schlummert nur, bereit für den kleinsten Anstoß.
gear-armour#0291.flat: These hollowed spikes still hold the lingering embers of the event that formed this caldera long ago, lending an almost unnatural glow. It's a comforting warmth, though the force of the eruption remains dormant, primed for the slightest push.

gear-armour#0292.src: The carapace of the common Maexi pet fire scarabs, while alone, only cause minor burns to the touch. However, when woven together, they produce a variety of cumulative effects.
gear-armour#0292.dst: Der Panzer der gewöhnlichen Feuerskarabäen, die man in Maex als Haustiere hält, verursacht allein nur leichte Verbrennungen bei Berührung. Zusammengewoben erzeugen sie jedoch eine Vielzahl sich steigernder Effekte.
gear-armour#0292.flat: The carapace of the common Maexi pet fire scarabs, while alone, only cause minor burns to the touch. However, when woven together, they produce a variety of cumulative effects.

gear-armour#0293.src: An oasis of flame, where noone can hurt you. Through abhorrence and loathing, you may create a world where all things burn, and a perfectly beautiful world it will be indeed.
gear-armour#0293.dst: Eine Oase aus Flammen, wo dir niemand wehtun kann. Durch Abscheu und Hass kannst du eine Welt erschaffen, in der alles brennt, und es wird wahrlich eine vollkommen schöne Welt sein.
gear-armour#0293.flat: An oasis of flame, where noone can hurt you. Through abhorrence and loathing, you may create a world where all things burn, and a perfectly beautiful world it will be indeed.

gear-armour#0294.src: Seek the opportune moment. Every wall has a crack that opens when the pressure shifts. Strike decisively when the light seeps through. The treasure will be yours.
gear-armour#0294.dst: Warte auf den günstigen Moment. Jede Mauer hat einen Riss, der sich öffnet, wenn sich der Druck verschiebt. Schlag entschlossen zu, wenn das Licht hindurchsickert. Der Schatz wird dir gehören.
gear-armour#0294.flat: Seek the opportune moment. Every wall has a crack that opens when the pressure shifts. Strike decisively when the light seeps through. The treasure will be yours.

gear-armour#0295.src: Seize the fleeting moment. Every tick of the clock is priceless, so pack every second with thrill, action, and laughter, and live the day to the fullest.
gear-armour#0295.dst: Ergreife den flüchtigen Moment. Jedes Ticken der Uhr ist unbezahlbar, also füll jede Sekunde mit Nervenkitzel, Action und Lachen und lebe den Tag in vollen Zügen.
gear-armour#0295.flat: Seize the fleeting moment. Every tick of the clock is priceless, so pack every second with thrill, action, and laughter, and live the day to the fullest.

gear-armour#0296.src: The grave leaves its mark on any who have been there. Few make it out; fewer still can bring their minds, too, back to life.
gear-armour#0296.dst: Das Grab hinterlässt seine Spuren bei allen, die dort waren. Nur wenige kommen heraus; noch weniger können auch ihren Geist wieder zum Leben erwecken.
gear-armour#0296.flat: The grave leaves its mark on any who have been there. Few make it out; fewer still can bring their minds, too, back to life.

gear-armour#0297.src: Barrages of rain and ice can bite and break; symphonies thunder and wind can deafen and crash. The worst storms, though, the kind that leave no survivors; those creep up quietly, steal in through the moonlit fields, and whisk the world away without a trace.
gear-armour#0297.dst: Regen- und Eissalven können beißen und brechen; Sinfonien aus Donner und Wind können betäuben und krachen. Die schlimmsten Stürme jedoch, die, die keine Überlebenden zurücklassen, schleichen sich leise an, stehlen sich über die mondbeschienenen Felder und fegen die Welt spurlos hinfort.
gear-armour#0297.flat: Barrages of rain and ice can bite and break; symphonies thunder and wind can deafen and crash. The worst storms, though, the kind that leave no survivors; those creep up quietly, steal in through the moonlit fields, and whisk the world away without a trace.

gear-armour#0298.src: Bending the fabric of reality to allow the wearer to take massive strides, these boots are rumored to contain rogue djinni to power them.
gear-armour#0298.dst: Diese Stiefel verbiegen das Gefüge der Wirklichkeit, damit ihr Träger gewaltige Schritte machen kann; man munkelt, abtrünnige Dschinns trieben sie an.
gear-armour#0298.flat: Bending the fabric of reality to allow the wearer to take massive strides, these boots are rumored to contain rogue djinni to power them.

gear-armour#0299.src: A gentle, warm glow for the weak, and flames of condemnation for the wicked. Such is the doctrine you follow, and thus, the will you shall enact upon this earth.
gear-armour#0299.dst: Ein sanftes, warmes Leuchten für die Schwachen und Flammen der Verdammnis für die Bösen. Das ist die Lehre, der du folgst, und somit der Wille, den du auf dieser Erde vollstrecken wirst.
gear-armour#0299.flat: A gentle, warm glow for the weak, and flames of condemnation for the wicked. Such is the doctrine you follow, and thus, the will you shall enact upon this earth.

gear-armour#0300.src: The shifting mosaic that graces the winter skies has always struck you as a faint trace of some grand precursor, pure and whole. As you look up at what remains, fragmented beyond the horizon, you can't help but wonder what it would take to break it once more.
gear-armour#0300.dst: Das wandelnde Mosaik, das den Winterhimmel ziert, kam dir immer wie die schwache Spur eines großen, reinen und ganzen Vorläufers vor. Wenn du zu dem aufblickst, was davon übrig ist, zersplittert jenseits des Horizonts, fragst du dich unwillkürlich, was es bräuchte, um es erneut zu zerbrechen.
gear-armour#0300.flat: The shifting mosaic that graces the winter skies has always struck you as a faint trace of some grand precursor, pure and whole. As you look up at what remains, fragmented beyond the horizon, you can't help but wonder what it would take to break it once more.

gear-armour#0301.src: Despite being thin enough to blow away in the wind, this mineral-blended shawl holds the force of a supervolcano within its soft fabric.
gear-armour#0301.dst: Obwohl er so dünn ist, dass der Wind ihn fortwehen könnte, birgt dieser mit Mineralien durchsetzte Schal in seinem weichen Stoff die Kraft eines Supervulkans.
gear-armour#0301.flat: Despite being thin enough to blow away in the wind, this mineral-blended shawl holds the force of a supervolcano within its soft fabric.

gear-armour#0302.src: There have been many attempts to create a reliable power system in {p}, and this plasma-charged helmet was reforged from a notable prototype.
gear-armour#0302.dst: In {p} gab es viele Versuche, ein verlässliches Energiesystem zu schaffen, und dieser plasmageladene Helm wurde aus einem bemerkenswerten Prototyp umgeschmiedet.
gear-armour#0302.flat: There have been many attempts to create a reliable power system in {p}, and this plasma-charged helmet was reforged from a notable prototype.
gear-armour#0302._raw: There have been many attempts to create a reliable power system in Llevigar, and this plasma-charged helmet was reforged from a notable prototype.

gear-armour#0303.src: The law of the ancients was clear on the matter. The law of the jungle was, too. Tradition and nature agree: power can only be held by those with the strength to wield it.
gear-armour#0303.dst: Das Gesetz der Alten war in dieser Sache eindeutig. Das Gesetz des Dschungels ebenso. Tradition und Natur sind sich einig: Macht kann nur halten, wer die Stärke hat, sie zu führen.
gear-armour#0303.flat: The law of the ancients was clear on the matter. The law of the jungle was, too. Tradition and nature agree: power can only be held by those with the strength to wield it.

gear-armour#0305.src: Many artifacts are found to incite rage in the wearer, and wizards old and new alike conjecture as to the purpose of them. Very few increase the latent abilities of the wearers to ensure havoc, and none to such a degree as these boots.
gear-armour#0305.dst: Viele Artefakte entfachen Wut in ihrem Träger, und alte wie neue Zauberer rätseln über ihren Zweck. Nur sehr wenige steigern die schlummernden Fähigkeiten ihrer Träger, um Verwüstung zu garantieren, und keines in solchem Maß wie diese Stiefel.
gear-armour#0305.flat: Many artifacts are found to incite rage in the wearer, and wizards old and new alike conjecture as to the purpose of them. Very few increase the latent abilities of the wearers to ensure havoc, and none to such a degree as these boots.

gear-armour#0306.src: According to the tag on the heels, these boots leave a trail of snow no matter  where one walks with them.
gear-armour#0306.dst: Laut dem Etikett an den Fersen hinterlassen diese Stiefel eine Schneespur, ganz gleich,  wohin man mit ihnen geht.
gear-armour#0306.flat: According to the tag on the heels, these boots leave a trail of snow no matter  where one walks with them.

gear-armour#0307.src: These boots were standard issue to members of the prestigious, and now disbanded, Sodeta Guild, and given as a gift to the owners of Delnar Mansion one day.
gear-armour#0307.dst: Diese Stiefel gehörten zur Standardausrüstung der Mitglieder der angesehenen, inzwischen aufgelösten Sodeta-Gilde und wurden eines Tages den Besitzern des Delnar-Herrenhauses geschenkt.
gear-armour#0307.flat: These boots were standard issue to members of the prestigious, and now disbanded, Sodeta Guild, and given as a gift to the owners of Delnar Mansion one day.

gear-armour#0308.src: A sweet tune permeates the air. A whistle on the waves; a melody from the depths. It calls forth destruction in seafoam and sand, and those who hear its call do not breathe for long.
gear-armour#0308.dst: Eine süße Melodie erfüllt die Luft. Ein Pfeifen auf den Wellen; eine Weise aus der Tiefe. Sie ruft Zerstörung in Gischt und Sand hervor, und wer ihren Ruf hört, atmet nicht mehr lange.
gear-armour#0308.flat: A sweet tune permeates the air. A whistle on the waves; a melody from the depths. It calls forth destruction in seafoam and sand, and those who hear its call do not breathe for long.

gear-armour#0309.src: Taken from the Archwraith by a pious Shaman, this chestplate was immediately abandoned. Its few users since have turned to an all-consuming desire to seek out and realign the last vestiges of purity remaining in the {p}.
gear-armour#0309.dst: Ein frommer Schamane entriss diesen Brustpanzer dem Erzgespenst und ließ ihn sofort liegen. Seine wenigen Träger seither verfielen einem alles verzehrenden Verlangen, die letzten Spuren der Reinheit in {p} aufzuspüren und neu auszurichten.
gear-armour#0309.flat: Taken from the Archwraith by a pious Shaman, this chestplate was immediately abandoned. Its few users since have turned to an all-consuming desire to seek out and realign the last vestiges of purity remaining in the {p}.
gear-armour#0309._raw: Taken from the Archwraith by a pious Shaman, this chestplate was immediately abandoned. Its few users since have turned to an all-consuming desire to seek out and realign the last vestiges of purity remaining in the Kander Forest.

gear-armour#0310.src: Your mind is ripped away from reality, puppeting the ghost of a vessel that once held your brilliant spirit. But here, now, you can do things you never before thought possible. They cannot touch you here, here in the realm where the shadows live.
gear-armour#0310.dst: Dein Geist wird aus der Wirklichkeit gerissen und lenkt wie eine Marionette den Geist eines Gefäßes, das einst deine strahlende Seele beherbergte. Doch hier, jetzt, kannst du Dinge tun, die du nie für möglich gehalten hättest. Hier können sie dich nicht berühren, hier im Reich, in dem die Schatten leben.
gear-armour#0310.flat: Your mind is ripped away from reality, puppeting the ghost of a vessel that once held your brilliant spirit. But here, now, you can do things you never before thought possible. They cannot touch you here, here in the realm where the shadows live.

gear-armour#0311.src: The dark spectres of the decayed forests have created an insidious helmet to drain the spirit of those who wear it, and become servants to their dark whims. Many have fallen to its allure.
gear-armour#0311.dst: Die dunklen Gespenster der verfallenen Wälder haben einen heimtückischen Helm geschaffen, der den Geist seiner Träger aussaugt, sodass sie zu Dienern ihrer finsteren Launen werden. Viele sind seinem Reiz erlegen.
gear-armour#0311.flat: The dark spectres of the decayed forests have created an insidious helmet to drain the spirit of those who wear it, and become servants to their dark whims. Many have fallen to its allure.

gear-armour#0312.src: "...Spiders have a weak point in the cephalothorax, essentially the neck. A small target, but it isn't as tough to chop through as the rest of them. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter {~}
gear-armour#0312.dst: "...Spinnen haben eine Schwachstelle am Kopfbruststück, im Grunde dem Hals. Ein kleines Ziel, aber es lässt sich nicht so schwer durchtrennen wie der Rest von ihnen. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Leitfaden zu den Gefahren von Nivla, Kapitel {~}
gear-armour#0312.flat: "...Spiders have a weak point in the cephalothorax, essentially the neck. A small target, but it isn't as tough to chop through as the rest of them. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter {~}
gear-armour#0312._raw: "...Spiders have a weak point in the cephalothorax, essentially the neck. A small target, but it isn't as tough to chop through as the rest of them. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3

gear-armour#0313.src: "After nearly getting trapped in an iron maiden, I figure I can study  those mummies just as well from home." -Achper, {p} Archaeologist
gear-armour#0313.dst: "Nachdem ich fast in einer eisernen Jungfrau gefangen war, denke ich, dass ich diese Mumien genauso gut von zu Hause aus studieren kann." -Achper, Archäologe aus {p}
gear-armour#0313.flat: "After nearly getting trapped in an iron maiden, I figure I can study  those mummies just as well from home." -Achper, {p} Archaeologist
gear-armour#0313._raw: "After nearly getting trapped in an iron maiden, I figure I can study  those mummies just as well from home." -Achper, Almuj Archaeologist

gear-armour#0314.src: Although these boots are crafted from corrupted stone, they do not exhibit any corruptive effects on their wearers. Speculation abounds as to the reason.
gear-armour#0314.dst: Obwohl diese Stiefel aus verderbtem Stein gefertigt sind, zeigen sie keinerlei verderbende Wirkung auf ihre Träger. Über den Grund wird viel spekuliert.
gear-armour#0314.flat: Although these boots are crafted from corrupted stone, they do not exhibit any corruptive effects on their wearers. Speculation abounds as to the reason.

gear-armour#0316.src: Wybels have a strange attraction to cosmic magic, and many an owner will find them staring through the window at night. One, however, claims to have seen her Wybel making something out of white stardust. The abode was robbed shortly after, and the supposed item gone missing without confirmation of its existence.
gear-armour#0316.dst: Wybels fühlen sich seltsam zu kosmischer Magie hingezogen, und so mancher Halter findet sie nachts aus dem Fenster starrend. Eine Halterin behauptet jedoch, gesehen zu haben, wie ihr Wybel etwas aus weißem Sternenstaub fertigte. Kurz darauf wurde in die Wohnung eingebrochen, und der angebliche Gegenstand verschwand, ohne dass seine Existenz je bestätigt wurde.
gear-armour#0316.flat: Wybels have a strange attraction to cosmic magic, and many an owner will find them staring through the window at night. One, however, claims to have seen her Wybel making something out of white stardust. The abode was robbed shortly after, and the supposed item gone missing without confirmation of its existence.

gear-armour#0317.src: Forged in a hidden workshop, these boots were imbued with earthen quartz and bound lightning. Their wearer crackles with static energy, amplifying every strike. Many have chased this power, only to find themselves uprooted by its shocking embrace.
gear-armour#0317.dst: In einer verborgenen Werkstatt geschmiedet, wurden diese Stiefel mit erdigem Quarz und gebundenen Blitzen durchdrungen. Ihr Träger knistert vor statischer Energie, die jeden Schlag verstärkt. Viele haben dieser Macht nachgejagt, nur um von ihrer schockierenden Umarmung entwurzelt zu werden.
gear-armour#0317.flat: Forged in a hidden workshop, these boots were imbued with earthen quartz and bound lightning. Their wearer crackles with static energy, amplifying every strike. Many have chased this power, only to find themselves uprooted by its shocking embrace.

gear-armour#0318.src: Ground yourself. Your heart beats to the rhythm of the earth. With the weight of the world supporting you, nothing can break your stride.
gear-armour#0318.dst: Erde dich. Dein Herz schlägt im Rhythmus der Erde. Mit dem Gewicht der Welt als Stütze kann nichts deinen Schritt brechen.
gear-armour#0318.flat: Ground yourself. Your heart beats to the rhythm of the earth. With the weight of the world supporting you, nothing can break your stride.

gear-armour#0319.src: A rogue inventor stole the plans for a steam jet booster from Corkus and reverse engineered them onto a set of boots. While effective, they are dangerous, prone to catastrophic failure.
gear-armour#0319.dst: Ein abtrünniger Erfinder stahl die Pläne für einen Dampfdüsenbooster aus Corkus und baute sie in ein Paar Stiefel nach. So wirksam sie sind, sie sind gefährlich und neigen zu katastrophalem Versagen.
gear-armour#0319.flat: A rogue inventor stole the plans for a steam jet booster from Corkus and reverse engineered them onto a set of boots. While effective, they are dangerous, prone to catastrophic failure.

gear-armour#0320.src: The beauty of this peculiar grotto takes your breath away. Unfortunately, its spores do too...
gear-armour#0320.dst: Die Schönheit dieser eigenartigen Grotte raubt dir den Atem. Leider tun ihre Sporen das auch...
gear-armour#0320.flat: The beauty of this peculiar grotto takes your breath away. Unfortunately, its spores do too...

gear-armour#0321.src: "You should see when the spiders fight over a meal. It looks ridiculous, legs flailing everywhere!" -Captain Enduyn, {p} Legion {~}st Division
gear-armour#0321.dst: "Du solltest sehen, wenn die Spinnen sich um eine Mahlzeit streiten. Sieht lächerlich aus, überall zappelnde Beine!" -Hauptmann Enduyn, Legion von {p}, {~}. Division
gear-armour#0321.flat: "You should see when the spiders fight over a meal. It looks ridiculous, legs flailing everywhere!" -Captain Enduyn, {p} Legion {~}st Division
gear-armour#0321._raw: "You should see when the spiders fight over a meal. It looks ridiculous, legs flailing everywhere!" -Captain Enduyn, Ragni Legion 1st Division

gear-armour#0322.src: The carving on this archaic piece of armor writes: Ketlednah Icsul
gear-armour#0322.dst: Die Gravur auf diesem uralten Rüstungsteil lautet: Ketlednah Icsul
gear-armour#0322.flat: The carving on this archaic piece of armor writes: Ketlednah Icsul

gear-armour#0323.src: Forged from the storm-touched ether, this chest piece calls its wearer to rise above the sky. With every step, the pull of the earth weakens. Jump, and for a moment, you are weightless-caught between the clouds and the stars. Leap, and the heavens may answer.
gear-armour#0323.dst: Aus sturmberührtem Äther geschmiedet, ruft dieses Bruststück seinen Träger, sich über den Himmel zu erheben. Mit jedem Schritt wird der Zug der Erde schwächer. Spring, und für einen Moment bist du schwerelos-gefangen zwischen Wolken und Sternen. Wage den Sprung, und der Himmel antwortet vielleicht.
gear-armour#0323.flat: Forged from the storm-touched ether, this chest piece calls its wearer to rise above the sky. With every step, the pull of the earth weakens. Jump, and for a moment, you are weightless-caught between the clouds and the stars. Leap, and the heavens may answer.

gear-armour#0324.src: The cost of survival is immense, with morale running thin and supply lines choked, feeding the strength of an army condensed to a single point, of a people desperate not to give an inch.
gear-armour#0324.dst: Der Preis des Überlebens ist gewaltig: Die Moral schwindet und die Nachschubwege sind abgeschnürt, während die Stärke eines Heeres, auf einen einzigen Punkt verdichtet, ein Volk nährt, das verzweifelt keinen Fingerbreit weichen will.
gear-armour#0324.flat: The cost of survival is immense, with morale running thin and supply lines choked, feeding the strength of an army condensed to a single point, of a people desperate not to give an inch.

gear-armour#0325.src: Echoes of the Fracturing persist in the Sky at scales unimaginable, implying a power so all-encompassing it leaves you in awe.
gear-armour#0325.dst: Echos der Zersplitterung halten sich am Himmel in unvorstellbarem Ausmaß und deuten auf eine so allumfassende Macht hin, dass sie dich in Ehrfurcht versetzt.
gear-armour#0325.flat: Echoes of the Fracturing persist in the Sky at scales unimaginable, implying a power so all-encompassing it leaves you in awe.

gear-armour#0326.src: The most poignant anthems are the toils of a tortured soul, a haunting, heart-wrenching melody from which one can never turn away.
gear-armour#0326.dst: Die ergreifendsten Hymnen sind die Mühen einer gequälten Seele, eine eindringliche, herzzerreißende Melodie, von der man sich nie abwenden kann.
gear-armour#0326.flat: The most poignant anthems are the toils of a tortured soul, a haunting, heart-wrenching melody from which one can never turn away.

gear-armour#0327.src: The Expanse holds an exigent paranoia, a hamartia for even the most renowned heroes. Only a survivor knows to hoard intelligence, showing their hand only when none will be left to recount it.
gear-armour#0327.dst: Das Expanse birgt eine drängende Paranoia, ein fataler Fehler selbst für die berühmtesten Helden. Nur ein Überlebender weiß Wissen zu horten und seine Karten erst dann aufzudecken, wenn niemand mehr übrig ist, der davon erzählen könnte.
gear-armour#0327.flat: The Expanse holds an exigent paranoia, a hamartia for even the most renowned heroes. Only a survivor knows to hoard intelligence, showing their hand only when none will be left to recount it.

gear-armour#0328.src: The hide of the Touroto, an almost invincible Bull-like creature, is said to be pierced only by the horn of the Touroto itself, making it extremely valuable.
gear-armour#0328.dst: Das Fell des Touroto, eines fast unbesiegbaren, stierähnlichen Geschöpfs, soll nur vom Horn des Touroto selbst durchbohrt werden können, was es äußerst wertvoll macht.
gear-armour#0328.flat: The hide of the Touroto, an almost invincible Bull-like creature, is said to be pierced only by the horn of the Touroto itself, making it extremely valuable.

gear-armour#0330.src: Worn by a terrible berserker during his fanatical rampage through the land, his rage permeates this horned blackiron helmet.
gear-armour#0330.dst: Getragen von einem schrecklichen Berserker während seines fanatischen Wütens durchs Land, ist dieser gehörnte Schwarzeisenhelm von seinem Zorn durchdrungen.
gear-armour#0330.flat: Worn by a terrible berserker during his fanatical rampage through the land, his rage permeates this horned blackiron helmet.

gear-armour#0331.src: While only a mockery of the original product, this line of helmets became wildly popular before legal disputes and safety concerns halted production.
gear-armour#0331.dst: Obwohl nur ein Abklatsch des Originals, wurde diese Helmserie äußerst beliebt, bis Rechtsstreitigkeiten und Sicherheitsbedenken die Produktion stoppten.
gear-armour#0331.flat: While only a mockery of the original product, this line of helmets became wildly popular before legal disputes and safety concerns halted production.

gear-armour#0332.src: Jingle jangle, while shaking your bells. Jingle jangle come the pockets of cash... Catch the trickster, send them to hell," their money is gone and off you've dashed!
gear-armour#0332.dst: Klingeling, klingelang, während du die Glöckchen schüttelst. Klingeling, klingelang, klimpern die Taschen voll Geld... Fangt den Gauner, zur Hölle mit ihm!", ihr Geld ist weg, und du bist schon davongeflitzt!
gear-armour#0332.flat: Jingle jangle, while shaking your bells. Jingle jangle come the pockets of cash... Catch the trickster, send them to hell," their money is gone and off you've dashed!

gear-armour#0333.src: To the victor go the spoils. To the swift, go the spoils of the victor.
gear-armour#0333.dst: Dem Sieger gehört die Beute. Dem Schnellen gehört die Beute des Siegers.
gear-armour#0333.flat: To the victor go the spoils. To the swift, go the spoils of the victor.

gear-armour#0334.src: "I have hope in me the likes of which you could never imagine, and despair the likes of which you shall never fathom. If I cannot satisfy the one, then I will indulge the other."
gear-armour#0334.dst: "In mir ist Hoffnung, wie du sie dir niemals vorstellen könntest, und Verzweiflung, wie du sie niemals ergründen wirst. Kann ich die eine nicht stillen, so gebe ich mich der anderen hin."
gear-armour#0334.flat: "I have hope in me the likes of which you could never imagine, and despair the likes of which you shall never fathom. If I cannot satisfy the one, then I will indulge the other."

gear-armour#0335.src: The scratching in the walls is the only warning you get.
gear-armour#0335.dst: Das Kratzen in den Wänden ist die einzige Warnung, die du bekommst.
gear-armour#0335.flat: The scratching in the walls is the only warning you get.

gear-armour#0336.src: The Bantisu monks have developed this enigmatic sigil in their years of meditation and study. It blesses the wearer with luck and powerful psionic ability.
gear-armour#0336.dst: Die Bantisu-Mönche haben dieses rätselhafte Siegel in ihren Jahren der Meditation und des Studiums entwickelt. Es segnet seinen Träger mit Glück und mächtigen psionischen Fähigkeiten.
gear-armour#0336.flat: The Bantisu monks have developed this enigmatic sigil in their years of meditation and study. It blesses the wearer with luck and powerful psionic ability.

gear-armour#0337.src: The home of the storms, where the cramped clouds crackle and power surges in sharp bolts.
gear-armour#0337.dst: Die Heimat der Stürme, wo die gedrängten Wolken knistern und Energie in grellen Blitzen hervorbricht.
gear-armour#0337.flat: The home of the storms, where the cramped clouds crackle and power surges in sharp bolts.

gear-armour#0338.src: You only have limited time. But what if, you could experience that time again? And again, and again...
gear-armour#0338.dst: Du hast nur begrenzt Zeit. Doch was, wenn du diese Zeit noch einmal erleben könntest? Und noch einmal, und noch einmal...
gear-armour#0338.flat: You only have limited time. But what if, you could experience that time again? And again, and again...

gear-armour#0339.src: Chronological anomalies sometimes split themselves open, with no rhyme or reason. Catch one at the right time, and you'll find yourself somewhen else.
gear-armour#0339.dst: Zeitliche Anomalien reißen manchmal ohne Sinn und Verstand auf. Erwischst du eine im richtigen Moment, findest du dich irgendwann anders wieder.
gear-armour#0339.flat: Chronological anomalies sometimes split themselves open, with no rhyme or reason. Catch one at the right time, and you'll find yourself somewhen else.

gear-armour#0340.src: Tisaun, a warrior tasked to fend off a corrupted siege alone, could find only a thin shirt and rusted spear to use before the attack. He defeated all {~} enemies without taking a scratch, and his bravery infused his gear with that same strength.
gear-armour#0340.dst: Tisaun, ein Krieger, der allein eine Belagerung durch die Verderbten abwehren sollte, fand vor dem Angriff nur ein dünnes Hemd und einen rostigen Speer. Er besiegte alle {~} Feinde ohne einen Kratzer, und sein Mut erfüllte seine Ausrüstung mit derselben Stärke.
gear-armour#0340.flat: Tisaun, a warrior tasked to fend off a corrupted siege alone, could find only a thin shirt and rusted spear to use before the attack. He defeated all {~} enemies without taking a scratch, and his bravery infused his gear with that same strength.
gear-armour#0340._raw: Tisaun, a warrior tasked to fend off a corrupted siege alone, could find only a thin shirt and rusted spear to use before the attack. He defeated all 1000 enemies without taking a scratch, and his bravery infused his gear with that same strength.

gear-armour#0341.src: Crudely misshapen greaves made from haphazard scrap found about the Starfield. You sense a foreboding notion that donning such a thing would be the end of sensing anything at all.
gear-armour#0341.dst: Grob verformte Beinschienen aus wahllos zusammengeklaubtem Schrott vom Starfield. Du ahnst unheilvoll, dass so etwas anzulegen das Letzte wäre, was du je spüren würdest.
gear-armour#0341.flat: Crudely misshapen greaves made from haphazard scrap found about the Starfield. You sense a foreboding notion that donning such a thing would be the end of sensing anything at all.

gear-armour#0342.src: This is futile, a fight against odds so great you may as well challenge the force of fate itself. Yet there is pride to be found in delaying the inevitable, so stand your ground and fight to the end.
gear-armour#0342.dst: Es ist zwecklos, ein Kampf gegen so große Übermacht, dass du ebenso gut das Schicksal selbst herausfordern könntest. Doch es liegt Stolz darin, das Unvermeidliche hinauszuzögern, also bleib standhaft und kämpfe bis zum Ende.
gear-armour#0342.flat: This is futile, a fight against odds so great you may as well challenge the force of fate itself. Yet there is pride to be found in delaying the inevitable, so stand your ground and fight to the end.

gear-armour#0343.src: There's a new voice in your head. An echo, a scratch at the back of your brain, bursting with all the memories of a life you've never led and the desires of a will you do not hold and the fears of a mind that is not yours. Won't you let it out? After all, two hearts beat stronger than one.
gear-armour#0343.dst: In deinem Kopf ist eine neue Stimme. Ein Echo, ein Kratzen im Hinterkopf, voller Erinnerungen an ein Leben, das du nie geführt hast, Wünsche eines Willens, den du nicht hast, und Ängste eines Geistes, der nicht deiner ist. Willst du es nicht herauslassen? Schließlich schlagen zwei Herzen stärker als eines.
gear-armour#0343.flat: There's a new voice in your head. An echo, a scratch at the back of your brain, bursting with all the memories of a life you've never led and the desires of a will you do not hold and the fears of a mind that is not yours. Won't you let it out? After all, two hearts beat stronger than one.

gear-armour#0344.src: In sleep we are unfettered, unhindered by the choices we make. In dream we are unbound, set free to the limits of imagination.
gear-armour#0344.dst: Im Schlaf sind wir ungefesselt, frei von den Entscheidungen, die wir treffen. Im Traum sind wir ungebunden, frei bis an die Grenzen der Vorstellungskraft.
gear-armour#0344.flat: In sleep we are unfettered, unhindered by the choices we make. In dream we are unbound, set free to the limits of imagination.

gear-armour#0345.src: This excessively ornate to-the-point-of-being-wasteful decorative mask, laser-cut from a meter's worth of pure diamond, is given to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then pushed onward to prove that they will not stop spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.
gear-armour#0345.dst: Diese bis zur Verschwendung übertrieben prunkvolle Ziermaske, per Laser aus einem Meter reinem Diamant geschnitten, wird jenen verliehen, die unnötig viel Zeit damit verbracht haben, die Legendary Challenge abzuschließen, mit allen Konventionen gebrochen haben, indem sie weiter unnötig viel Zeit damit verbrachten, die Legendary Challenge abzuschließen, noch weit darüber hinausgegangen sind, unnötig viel Zeit damit zu verbringen, die Legendary Challenge abzuschließen, und dann weitergemacht haben, um zu beweisen, dass sie nicht aufhören werden, unnötig viel Zeit damit zu verbringen, die Legendary Challenge abzuschließen.
ctx: armour/Treasured Diamond Mask of Legendary Victory/lore
gear-armour#0345.flat: This excessively ornate to-the-point-of-being-wasteful decorative mask, laser-cut from a meter's worth of pure diamond, is given to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then pushed onward to prove that they will not stop spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

gear-armour#0346.src: Wait it out. Even the darkest storm clouds will eventually run out of rain if you give them enough time. Step back. Breathe. The sky clears on its own once the sun has had its say.
gear-armour#0346.dst: Sitz es aus. Selbst den dunkelsten Gewitterwolken geht irgendwann der Regen aus, wenn du ihnen genug Zeit gibst. Tritt zurück. Atme. Der Himmel klart von selbst auf, sobald die Sonne ihr Wort gesprochen hat.
gear-armour#0346.flat: Wait it out. Even the darkest storm clouds will eventually run out of rain if you give them enough time. Step back. Breathe. The sky clears on its own once the sun has had its say.

gear-armour#0347.src: An ephemeral moment in time captured by sheer force of magic, this ornately-crafted cloak is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.
gear-armour#0347.dst: Ein flüchtiger Augenblick, eingefangen durch die schiere Kraft der Magie: Dieser kunstvoll gefertigte Umhang wird nur denen verliehen, die die Herrin des Bienenstocks bezwungen haben.
gear-armour#0347.flat: An ephemeral moment in time captured by sheer force of magic, this ornately-crafted cloak is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

gear-armour#0349.src: The Wanderer; the Betrayer; the Lunatic.
gear-armour#0349.dst: Der Wanderer; der Verräter; der Wahnsinnige.
gear-armour#0349.flat: The Wanderer; the Betrayer; the Lunatic.

gear-armour#0350.src: A once-great hero left behind these sturdy, reliable greaves, trusting those after her to be able to use their power to protect others, should they don them. Her courage fuels their wearers.
gear-armour#0350.dst: Eine einst große Heldin hinterließ diese robusten, verlässlichen Beinschienen im Vertrauen darauf, dass jene nach ihr ihre Kraft zum Schutz anderer nutzen würden, sollten sie sie anlegen. Ihr Mut beflügelt ihre Träger.
gear-armour#0350.flat: A once-great hero left behind these sturdy, reliable greaves, trusting those after her to be able to use their power to protect others, should they don them. Her courage fuels their wearers.

gear-armour#0351.src: This excessively ornate decorative mask, moulded from {~} carat gold, is awarded to those who have both spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge and broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.
gear-armour#0351.dst: Diese übertrieben prunkvolle Ziermaske, gegossen aus {~}-karätigem Gold, wird jenen verliehen, die sowohl unnötig viel Zeit damit verbracht haben, die Legendary Challenge abzuschließen, als auch mit allen Konventionen gebrochen haben, indem sie weiter unnötig viel Zeit damit verbrachten, die Legendary Challenge abzuschließen, und dann noch weit darüber hinausgegangen sind, unnötig viel Zeit damit zu verbringen, die Legendary Challenge abzuschließen.
ctx: armour/Venerated Gold Mask of Legendary Victory/lore
gear-armour#0351.flat: This excessively ornate decorative mask, moulded from {~} carat gold, is awarded to those who have both spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge and broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.
gear-armour#0351._raw: This excessively ornate decorative mask, moulded from 24 carat gold, is awarded to those who have both spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge and broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

gear-armour#0352.src: This ancient Elven sacrificial mask contains only a sliver of its previous magic, yet the blessing of the Elven god Entia still greatly empowers those who don it.
gear-armour#0352.dst: Diese uralte elfische Opfermaske birgt nur noch einen Hauch ihrer einstigen Magie, doch der Segen der elfischen Göttin Entia stärkt jene, die sie aufsetzen, noch immer gewaltig.
gear-armour#0352.flat: This ancient Elven sacrificial mask contains only a sliver of its previous magic, yet the blessing of the Elven god Entia still greatly empowers those who don it.

gear-armour#0353.src: Fashioned from the cut tails of the now extinct Venti, these nearly immaterial boots are light as air and crackle with lightning.
gear-armour#0353.dst: Aus den abgetrennten Schwänzen der inzwischen ausgestorbenen Venti gefertigt, sind diese fast stofflosen Stiefel leicht wie Luft und knistern vor Blitzen.
gear-armour#0353.flat: Fashioned from the cut tails of the now extinct Venti, these nearly immaterial boots are light as air and crackle with lightning.

gear-armour#0354.src: "A little belief, and just a little spirit, can go a long way."
gear-armour#0354.dst: "Ein wenig Glaube und nur ein wenig Mut können viel bewirken."
gear-armour#0354.flat: "A little belief, and just a little spirit, can go a long way."

gear-armour#0355.src: These common leather boots were once owned by a barbarian with no magical prowess. Instead of enchanting it, he coated the soles in corrupted shards to punish those who opposed him.
gear-armour#0355.dst: Diese gewöhnlichen Lederstiefel gehörten einst einem Barbaren ohne jedes magische Talent. Statt sie zu verzaubern, überzog er die Sohlen mit verderbten Splittern, um jene zu bestrafen, die sich ihm widersetzten.
gear-armour#0355.flat: These common leather boots were once owned by a barbarian with no magical prowess. Instead of enchanting it, he coated the soles in corrupted shards to punish those who opposed him.

gear-armour#0356.src: Are your heart, soul, and mind one? The ones who love are the most vulnerable. The ones who persist are the most detached. The ones who forget are the most naive. Only when you remove these impurities from your body could you reach the end.
gear-armour#0356.dst: Sind dein Herz, deine Seele und dein Geist eins? Wer liebt, ist am verwundbarsten. Wer beharrt, ist am losgelöstesten. Wer vergisst, ist am naivsten. Erst wenn du diese Unreinheiten aus deinem Körper entfernst, kannst du das Ende erreichen.
gear-armour#0356.flat: Are your heart, soul, and mind one? The ones who love are the most vulnerable. The ones who persist are the most detached. The ones who forget are the most naive. Only when you remove these impurities from your body could you reach the end.

gear-armour#0357.src: Sheer strength exudes from these Orcish relics, simple sandals ill-fitting to humans or Villagers. Enchanted with power and rage rather than magic, the strength that is provided when they are worn is unparalleled.
gear-armour#0357.dst: Rohe Kraft strömt aus diesen orkischen Relikten, schlichten Sandalen, die Menschen oder Dorfbewohnern schlecht passen. Mit Macht und Zorn statt mit Magie verzaubert, verleihen sie beim Tragen eine unvergleichliche Stärke.
gear-armour#0357.flat: Sheer strength exudes from these Orcish relics, simple sandals ill-fitting to humans or Villagers. Enchanted with power and rage rather than magic, the strength that is provided when they are worn is unparalleled.

gear-armour#0358.src: The depths of the seas, where the waves flow fierce and fast and wash away the agonies of the world.
gear-armour#0358.dst: Die Tiefen der Meere, wo die Wellen wild und schnell strömen und die Qualen der Welt fortspülen.
gear-armour#0358.flat: The depths of the seas, where the waves flow fierce and fast and wash away the agonies of the world.
